searchText: Is there a definitive piece of documentation that explains how various RPC methods should behave in failure mode? i.e. sendTransaction on revert and out of gas? (and call/estimateGas in those cases too) Not yet. Is there anything better than https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API ? (which doesn't cover much at all... I've had to wireshark some tests against <@&814631391181930606>/vm to figure out the expected behavior) Nope, we're working on a better standard that specifies the behavior and adds test cases
